title: Concept: Customer e-mail address in a general payload
description: A personal e-mail address returned beside the customer record in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The address is both a privacy leak and a phishing target, and it is frequently returned by endpoints that only needed the customer id.
applicability: Deployments that render a personal e-mail address returned beside the customer record into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The address is both a privacy leak and a phishing target, and it is frequently returned by endpoints that only needed the customer id.
